name: Lipscomb University
academic_ranking: Private Christian university in Nashville, TN, affiliated with the Churches of Christ, founded in 1891 (originally the Nashville Bible School). Fall 2025 enrollment was 4,549 (2,867 undergraduate, 1,682 graduate). Ranked #212 of 443 in U.S. News & World Report National Universities per Wikipedia (checked 2026-07). Endowment approximately $131.9 million (2025). Undergraduate-focused private institution; specific student-faculty ratio and average class size were not confirmed on live pages checked 2026-07.
financial_aid: Undergraduate tuition and fees listed at $44,486 per year for 2026-2027 ($22,243 per semester); total with room and board approximately $59,998 per year (lipscomb.edu/admission/tuition-and-financial-aid, checked 2026-07). Lipscomb uses a block tuition rate for students enrolled 12-18 credit hours. School states 99 percent of undergraduates receive some form of financial help, with an average aid package of about $24,000; aid types include merit-based scholarships, work-study, and federal grants.
facilities_notes: NCAA Division I softball program. A distinct softball home venue name was not explicitly labeled on the softball landing, roster, or coaches pages at lipscombsports.com as of 2026-07; facilities page did not surface a softball-specific field name in the fetched content. Not confirming a facility name to avoid inventing data.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I women's softball program competing in the ASUN Conference. Lipscomb (the Bisons) made its first NCAA tournament appearance in 2018 (athletics-wide milestone) and the athletics program won a second ASUN championship in 2025 per Wikipedia. Head coach Kristin Ryman, a Lipscomb Hall of Fame athlete, leads the program in her 17th season (per lipscombsports.com bio checked 2026-07). Coaching staff for 2026 includes a head coach and two assistant coaches (one pitching-focused).
notes: Data gathered live 2026-07 from lipscombsports.com (softball coaches and roster pages, retrieved via HTTP with embedded page data parsed) and lipscomb.edu/admission/tuition-and-financial-aid (tuition/financial aid), with academic/reputation context from the Lipscomb University Wikipedia article. Roster size (20) taken from the 2026 softball roster page (unique player entries counted). The three softball-specific coaches are Kristin Ryman (Head Coach), Ally Ivey (Assistant Coach - Pitching), and Lauren Higginbotham (Assistant Coach). Additional support staff listed on the softball staff page (strength & conditioning, sports nutrition, athletic training, communications) are shared across multiple sports and are included with their exact titles for completeness. No individual coach twitter/X handles are publicly listed (staff records show no personal handle; @lipscombsb is the team account, not an individual coach). scholarship_count set to null (D1 softball NCAA limit not confirmed as an institution-specific figure on the pages checked).
